summary: Rigel Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K (Item 2.01) reporting completion of its license agreement with Arvinas, Inc., Arvinas Operations, Inc., Arvinas Estrogen Receptor, Inc. and Pfizer Inc. (Licensors), obtaining exclusive global rights to develop, manufacture, and commercialize VEPPANU (vepdegestrant) and related products. Upon early termination of the HSR waiting period and satisfaction of other closing conditions, the agreement became effective, and Rigel paid a one-time upfront payment of $70.0 million. No additional deal terms (price per share, premium, etc.) were disclosed as it's a license rather than an equity acquisition. The regulatory clock cleared with HSR early termination. What to watch: Rigel's integration of clinical development for vepdegestrant; risk-arb angle is limited as this is an asset acquisition with fixed upfront payment.
